newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products strengthen on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products strengthen on tight supply.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Monday on tight supply, but demand was thin.
Gasoline barges were slightly firmer amid tight Rotterdam supply but business was thin.
Naphtha was firmer amid good demand for reforming grades which were seen in short supply.
Gas oil was firmer, especially on the barge market where prompt premiums have doubled since last Monday on tight supply.
High sulphur barges bounced $4 higher to $112 fob ARA on the back of tight supplies even though physical demand was slowish.
